elements.name: sql
elements.text:
SELECT channel,
  SUM(spend),
  COUNT(valid_lead),
  COUNT(recycle_order),
  SUM(final_margin)
FROM business_view
WHERE date >= :last_30_days
  AND channel IN ('抖音','百度')
GROUP BY channel;
